1	# WellStream Platform — Integrated Energy Data Management
     2	
     3	## Brand
     4	WellStream delivers integrated SaaS solutions for energy operators to manage well data, production, and land assets—streamlining operations and enhancing decision-making. From drilling to decommissioning, WellStream transforms every phase of energy operations with seamless, end-to-end data integration.
     5	
     6	Brand colors: #15295A (primary navy), #6CC24A (accent green), #3C424B (dark gray)
     7	
     8	## Hero Content
     9	Title: GET REAL-TIME DATA ACROSS YOUR ENTIRE OPERATION
    10	Subtitle: The integrated energy data platform built for operators who demand speed, security, and visibility across the well data lifecycle.
    11	CTA: "Explore the Platform" | "Request A Demo"
    12	
    13	## Featured Product Banner
    14	Product: WellStream Innova
    15	Tagline: Real-Time Drilling
    16	CTA: "Learn More"
    17	
    18	## Use Cases
    19	Label: USE CASES
    20	Heading: See the WellStream Platform in Action
    21	Description: From drilling to production, land to water, watch how WellStream transforms every phase of your operations. Streamline workflows, unlock real-time insights, and make every decision count with seamless, end-to-end data integration. Get it all—effortlessly.
    22	
    23	- **Drilling & Completions Management** — Centralize drilling programs, daily reports, and well design data in one accessible hub.
    24	- **Production Operations Oversight** — Monitor production volumes, allocations, and decline curves with real-time dashboards.
    25	- **Asset Integrity Monitoring** — Track well integrity risks, inspection schedules, and compliance status across your portfolio.
    26	- **Hydraulic Frac Data Centralization** — Consolidate frac stage data, chemical usage, and pressure readings for every completion.
    27	- **Facility Construction & Commissioning** — Manage site activity, construction milestones, and commissioning workflows digitally.
    28	- **Geospatial Asset Analysis** — Visualize well locations, land positions, and infrastructure on interactive map layers.
    29	
    30	CTA: "More Use Cases"
    31	
    32	## Platform Overview Diagram
    33	Three interconnected pillars of the WellStream Platform:
    34	- **Well Data Lifecycle** — Plan, drill, complete, and manage wells from spud to abandonment.
    35	- **Production Data Lifecycle** — Capture, allocate, report, and optimize production volumes.
    36	- **Land Data Management** — Track leases, agreements, obligations, and mineral rights.
    37	
    38	## Platform Benefits
    39	- **Save Time** — Eliminate manual data entry and redundant workflows with automated data capture and centralized reporting.
    40	- **Save Resources** — Reduce headcount dedicated to spreadsheet management by consolidating tools into one platform.
    41	- **Save Money** — Lower total cost of ownership versus maintaining multiple legacy systems and on-premise servers.
    42	- **Stay Connected** — Access your data from any device, anywhere, with cloud-native mobile and desktop applications.
    43	- **Stay Secure** — Enterprise-grade security with SOC compliance, SSO, and continuous monitoring protects your critical data.
    44	
    45	## Platform Statistics
    46	- **80** companies trust WellStream to manage their energy data
    47	- **89%** of clients are actively pursuing digital transformation initiatives
    48	- **31%** reported significant return on investment within the first year
    49	
    50	## Implementation Timeline
    51	- **3 WEEKS** — Independent Operator, from the demo to launch
    52	- **5 MONTHS** — Major Operator with extensive data log
    53	- **12 MONTHS** — Super Major International Operator
    54	
    55	## Accordion Features
    56	- **Get Speed** — Deploy in weeks, not years. Cloud-native architecture means zero hardware and instant scalability.
    57	- **Get Secure** — SOC 1 & 2 certified, Azure-powered infrastructure with 24/7 monitoring and encryption at rest and in transit.
    58	- **Get Mobility** — Field-ready mobile apps that sync in real time, even in low-connectivity environments.
    59	- **Get Real-Time Reporting** — Configurable dashboards deliver live KPIs to executives, engineers, and field teams simultaneously.
    60	- **Get Connected** — Open APIs, ETL pipelines, and pre-built connectors integrate WellStream with your existing tech stack.
    61	
    62	## Security Features
    63	- **SOC 1 & 2 Certified Compliance** — Annual third-party audits verify controls over financial and operational data handling.
    64	- **Powered by Microsoft Azure** — Enterprise cloud infrastructure with geo-redundant data centers and 99.95% uptime SLA.
    65	- **Performance Monitoring** — Continuous application and infrastructure monitoring with automated alerting and incident response.
    66	- **Single Sign-On (SSO) Authentication** — Integrate with your corporate identity provider for seamless, secure access management.
    67	- **Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) System** — Real-time log aggregation, threat detection, and forensic analysis across all platform components.
    68	
    69	## ETL Key Benefits
    70	- **Read-Only Snowflake Access** — Query your WellStream data directly in Snowflake without impacting production performance.
    71	- **Supports BI Warehousing** — Feed Power BI, Tableau, or Spotfire with clean, structured energy data pipelines.
    72	- **Handles Complex Use Cases** — Map multi-source data from SCADA, accounting, and regulatory systems into unified schemas.
    73	- **Improves System Interoperability** — Bridge legacy databases and modern cloud applications with managed ETL orchestration.
    74	
    75	## Integration Tabs
    76	- **ETL** — Automated extract-transform-load pipelines move data between WellStream and enterprise systems on schedule.
    77	- **APIs** — RESTful APIs enable real-time programmatic access for custom applications and third-party integrations.
    78	- **Dashboards** — Pre-built and configurable visualization layers surface insights without requiring data exports.
    79	
    80	## Company Culture
    81	Heading: WellStream: Fearless Innovation
    82	Description: At WellStream, innovation drives everything we do. From a two-person startup to a global leader, we've built a culture of collaboration and bold ideas. Join a team that empowers 600+ clients worldwide with cutting-edge solutions in well, production, and land data management. With mobility, automation, and data integration at our core, we're shaping the future of energy together.
    83	CTA: "Find Out More"
    84	
    85	## Renewables CTA
    86	Heading: WellStream Renewables
    87	Description: Unlock peak efficiency with WellStream Land. Our tools, LandView and LandView Map, supercharge solar, wind, utilities, geothermal, and carbon capture projects. Drive energy innovation and transform your operations now.
    88	CTA: "Find Out More"
    89	
    90	## Testimonials
    91	- "WellStream cut our reporting cycle from days to minutes. We finally have one source of truth." — VP Operations, Mid-Continent E&P
    92	- "Implementation was seamless. The team had us live in under four weeks." — Data Manager, Permian Basin Operator
    93	- "The mobile app changed how our field teams capture data—no more paper tickets." — Completions Engineer, Rockies Operator
    94	
    95	## Demo Form
    96	Heading: REQUEST A DEMO
    97	Description: Experience WellStream's integrated energy data platform firsthand. Schedule a personalized demo to see how our solutions can optimize your operations and increase profitability.
    98	Fields: First Name, Last Name, Business Email, Company, Phone Number, Job Title, Country, Comments
    99	CTA: "Submit"
   100	
   101	## Support Contact
   102	Global support available across North America, Latin America, and Middle East/North Africa regions. Contact our team for technical assistance, implementation questions, or partnership inquiries.
   103	
   104	## Well Data Lifecycle Products
   105	| Product | Function |
   106	|---------|----------|
   107	| WellView Allez | Well Data Management |
   108	| RigView | Rig Scheduling |
   109	| Well Reliability | Downtime Analysis |
   110	| Well Integrity | Risk Monitoring |
   111	| WellStream Frac | Frac Stage Tracking |
   112	| SiteView Allez | Site Activity Overview |
   113	| SiteView Go | Mobile Site Data |
   114	| WellStream Ram | Flow Optimization Model |
   115	| WellStream Innova | Real-time Directional Data Exchange |
   116	| WellStream Equipment | Equipment Tracking |
   117	| WellStream Water | Water Use Tracking |
   118	| WellStream Water Go | Mobile Water Management |
   119	| WellStream Dashboards | Clear Actionable Views |
   120	
   121	## Industry Tabs
   122	Tab labels: E&P · Midstream · Downstream · Utilities · Solar/Wind · Mining
   123	
   124	## Footer Navigation
   125	Platform: Platform Overview · Security · Integration · Services + Support
   126	Solutions: By Industry · By Use Case
   127	Company: About Us · Careers · Contact

1 --- 2 name: web-frameworks 3 description: Build modern full-stack web applications with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, RSC, PPR, SSR, SSG, ISR), Turborepo (monorepo management, task pipelines, remote caching, parallel execution), and RemixIcon (3100+ SVG icons in outlined/filled styles). Use when creating React applications, implementing server-side rendering, setting up monorepos with multiple packages, optimizing build performance and caching strategies, adding icon libraries, managing shared dependencies, or working with TypeScript full-stack projects. 4 license: MIT 5 version: 1.0.0 6 --- 7 8 # Web Frameworks Skill Group 9 10 Comprehensive guide for building modern full-stack web applications using Next.js, Turborepo, and RemixIcon. 11 12 ## Overview 13 14 This skill group combines three powerful tools for web development: 15 16 **Next.js** - React framework with SSR, SSG, RSC, and optimization features 17 **Turborepo** - High-performance monorepo build system for JavaScript/TypeScript 18 **RemixIcon** - Icon library with 3,100+ outlined and filled style icons 19 20 ## When to Use This Skill Group 21 22 - Building new full-stack web applications with modern React 23 - Setting up monorepos with multiple apps and shared packages 24 - Implementing server-side rendering and static generation 25 - Optimizing build performance with intelligent caching 26 - Creating consistent UI with professional iconography 27 - Managing workspace dependencies across multiple projects 28 - Deploying production-ready applications with proper optimization 29 30 ## Stack Selection Guide 31 32 ### Single Application: Next.js + RemixIcon 33 34 Use when building a standalone application: 35 - E-commerce sites 36 - Marketing websites 37 - SaaS applications 38 - Documentation sites 39 - Blogs and content platforms 40 41 **Setup:** 42 ```bash 43 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 44 cd my-app 45 npm install remixicon 46 ``` 47 48 ### Monorepo: Next.js + Turborepo + RemixIcon 49 50 Use when building multiple applications with shared code: 51 - Microfrontends 52 - Multi-tenant platforms 53 - Internal tools with shared component library 54 - Multiple apps (web, admin, mobile-web) sharing logic 55 - Design system with documentation site 56 57 **Setup:** 58 ```bash 59 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 60 # Then configure Next.js apps in apps/ directory 61 # Install remixicon in shared UI packages 62 ``` 63 64 ### Framework Features Comparison 65 66 | Feature | Next.js | Turborepo | RemixIcon | 67 |---------|---------|-----------|-----------| 68 | Primary Use | Web framework | Build system | UI icons | 69 | Best For | SSR/SSG apps | Monorepos | Consistent iconography | 70 | Performance | Built-in optimization | Caching & parallel tasks | Lightweight fonts/SVG | 71 | TypeScript | Full support | Full support | Type definitions available | 72 73 ## Quick Start 74 75 ### Next.js Application 76 77 ```bash 78 # Create new project 79 npx create-next-app@latest my-app 80 cd my-app 81 82 # Install RemixIcon 83 npm install remixicon 84 85 # Import in layout 86 # app/layout.tsx 87 import 'remixicon/fonts/remixicon.css' 88 89 # Start development 90 npm run dev 91 ``` 92 93 ### Turborepo Monorepo 94 95 ```bash 96 # Create monorepo 97 npx create-turbo@latest my-monorepo 98 cd my-monorepo 99 100 # Structure: 101 # apps/web/ - Next.js application 102 # apps/docs/ - Documentation site 103 # packages/ui/ - Shared components with RemixIcon 104 # packages/config/ - Shared configs 105 # turbo.json - Pipeline configuration 106 107 # Run all apps 108 npm run dev 109 110 # Build all packages 111 npm run build 112 ``` 113 114 ### RemixIcon Integration 115 116 ```tsx 117 // Webfont (HTML/CSS) 118 119 120 121 // React component 122 import { RiHomeLine, RiSearchFill } from "@remixicon/react" 123 124 125 ``` 126 127 ## Reference Navigation 128 129 **Next.js References:** 130 - [App Router Architecture](./references/nextjs-app-router.md) - Routing, layouts, pages, parallel routes 131 - [Server Components](./references/nextjs-server-components.md) - RSC patterns, client vs server, streaming 132 - [Data Fetching](./references/nextjs-data-fetching.md) - fetch API, caching, revalidation, loading states 133 - [Optimization](./references/nextjs-optimization.md) - Images, fonts, scripts, bundle analysis, PPR 134 135 **Turborepo References:** 136 - [Setup & Configuration](./references/turborepo-setup.md) - Installation, workspace config, package structure 137 - [Task Pipelines](./references/turborepo-pipelines.md) - Dependencies, parallel execution, task ordering 138 - [Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation 139 140 **RemixIcon References:** 141 - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility 142 143 ## Common Patterns & Workflows 144 145 ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo 146 147 ``` 148 my-monorepo/ 149 ├── apps/ 150 │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app 151 │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app 152 │ └── docs/ # Documentation site 153 ├── packages/ 154 │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon 155 │ ├── api-client/ # API client library 156 │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs 157 │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types 158 └── turbo.json # Build pipeline 159 ``` 160 161 **turbo.json:** 162 ```json 163 { 164 "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", 165 "pipeline": { 166 "build": { 167 "dependsOn": ["^build"], 168 "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] 169 }, 170 "dev": { 171 "cache": false, 172 "persistent": true 173 }, 174 "lint": {}, 175 "test": { 176 "dependsOn": ["build"] 177 } 178 } 179 } 180 ``` 181 182 ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library 183 184 ```tsx 185 // packages/ui/src/button.tsx 186 import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" 187 188 export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { 189 return ( 190 194 ) 195 } 196 197 // apps/web/app/page.tsx 198 import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" 199 import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" 200 201 export default function Page() { 202 return 203 } 204 ``` 205 206 ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching 207 208 ```tsx 209 // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx 210 import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' 211 212 // Static generation at build time 213 export async function generateStaticParams() { 214 const posts = await getPosts() 215 return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) 216 } 217 218 // Revalidate every hour 219 async function getPost(slug: string) { 220 const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { 221 next: { revalidate: 3600 } 222 }) 223 if (!res.ok) return null 224 return res.json() 225 } 226 227 export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { 228 const post = await getPost(params.slug) 229 if (!post) notFound() 230 231 return
{post.content}
232 } 233 ``` 234 235 ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline 236 237 ```yaml 238 # .github/workflows/ci.yml 239 name: CI 240 on: [push, pull_request] 241 242 jobs: 243 build: 244 runs-on: ubuntu-latest 245 steps: 246 - uses: actions/checkout@v4 247 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 248 with: 249 node-version: 18 250 - run: npm install 251 - run: npx turbo run build test lint 252 env: 253 TURBO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TOKEN }} 254 TURBO_TEAM: ${{ secrets.TURBO_TEAM }} 255 ``` 256 257 ## Utility Scripts 258 259 Python utilities in `scripts/` directory: 260 261 **nextjs-init.py** - Initialize Next.js project with best practices 262 **turborepo-migrate.py** - Convert existing monorepo to Turborepo 263 264 Usage examples: 265 ```bash 266 # Initialize new Next.js app with TypeScript and recommended setup 267 python scripts/nextjs-init.py --name my-app --typescript --app-router 268 269 # Migrate existing monorepo to Turborepo with dry-run 270 python scripts/turborepo-migrate.py --path ./my-monorepo --dry-run 271 272 # Run tests 273 cd scripts/tests 274 pytest 275 ``` 276 277 ## Best Practices 278 279 **Next.js:** 280 - Default to Server Components, use Client Components only when needed 281 - Implement proper loading and error states 282 - Use Image component for automatic optimization 283 - Set proper metadata for SEO 284 - Leverage caching strategies (force-cache, revalidate, no-store) 285 286 **Turborepo:** 287 - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) 288 - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) 289 - Configure outputs for proper caching 290 - Enable remote caching for team collaboration 291 - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only 292 293 **RemixIcon:** 294 - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis 295 - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering 296 - Provide aria-labels for accessibility 297 - Use currentColor for flexible theming 298 - Prefer webfonts for multiple icons, SVG for single icons 299 300 ## Resources 301 302 - Next.js: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt 303 - Turborepo: https://turbo.build/repo/docs 304 - RemixIcon: https://remixicon.com 305 306 ## Implementation Checklist 307 308 Building with this stack: 309 310 - [ ] Create project structure (single app or monorepo) 311 - [ ] Configure TypeScript and ESLint 312 - [ ] Set up Next.js with App Router 313 - [ ] Configure Turborepo pipeline (if monorepo) 314 - [ ] Install and configure RemixIcon 315 - [ ] Implement routing and layouts 316 - [ ] Add loading and error states 317 - [ ] Configure image and font optimization 318 - [ ] Set up data fetching patterns 319 - [ ] Configure caching strategies 320 - steps.message:
All 5 pages for the **WellStream Platform** landing site have been built and verified. Here's a summary of what was delivered:

---

### Output Location
`/app/output/` — all files are ready to open directly in a browser (no build step required).

### Files Created
| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `index.html` | Home page with hero, featured product banner, use cases grid, **industry tabs** (E&P/Midstream/Downstream/Utilities/Solar-Wind/Mining), platform ecosystem diagram, company culture & renewables CTA, cookie consent banner |
| `platform-overview.html` | Platform benefits, **circular stat indicators**, **implementation timeline with animated progress bars**, **accordion features** (Get Speed/Secure/Mobility/Reporting/Connected), **data lifecycle diagram**, **testimonial carousel** |
| `security.html` | Hero, **Security/SOC Compliance tabs**, security features grid, compliance CTA |
| `integration.html` | Hero, **ETL/APIs/Dashboards tabs**, integration features checklist, ETL benefits grid |
| `request-demo.html` | Demo request **form with validation** (required fields + email format), support contact cards |
| `css/styles.css` | Complete design system with dark navy/charcoal theme, electric blue/teal accents, responsive breakpoints |
| `js/main.js` | Tab switching, accordion toggle, testimonial carousel auto-play, cookie banner (Accept/Decline with localStorage), form validation, scroll animations for stats & timeline bars, mobile menu |

### Key Features Implemented
- **Persistent header** with Platform dropdown + "Request A Demo" CTA across all pages
- **Smooth tab interfaces** on home (industry), security (Security/SOC), and integration (ETL/APIs/Dashboards)
- **Accordion** with single-open behavior on platform-overview
- **Testimonial carousel** with dot navigation and auto-rotation
- **Cookie consent banner** on home page with localStorage persistence
- **Form validation** on demo request page with success state
- **Fully responsive** across desktop, tablet, and mobile
- **SVG/icon-based diagrams** (ecosystem pillars, data lifecycle nodes) — no placeholder images
- All inter-page links use relative paths
